description: This year-long course provides an opportunity for students to undertake a substantial research project under the supervision of faculty members of the School of Computing. Through this research collaboration, the student will experience first-hand the challenges and exhilaration of research, discovery and invention.
prerequisite: If undertaking an Undergraduate Degree THEN the student must have achieved at least 60 units prior to enrolment
prerequisiteRule: PROGRAM_TYPES IF_IN Undergraduate Degree THEN UNITS (60)
title: Undergraduate Research Project in Computing
